body:
Get the hottest Fintech Singapore News once a month in your Inbox

Linnovate has launched RAISE AI, an AI agent that works across its RAISE ecosystem to retrieve relevant data and generate reports and dashboards on demand.

The company said the tool helps alternative investment managers access portfolio insights without waiting for manual reporting cycles.

Users can ask questions in natural language and receive answers within moments.

The tool is designed for fund managers, finance and operations teams, investor relations professionals, compliance and risk teams, and investors.

How RAISE AI handles fund reporting

The agent generates reports covering key performance metrics, including internal rate of return (IRR), total value to paid-in capital (TVPI), distributions to paid-in capital (DPI) and net asset value (NAV). Users can generate these reports by fund, vintage or investor group using data from RAISE.

It also provides up-to-date insights into fund performance, cash flows and portfolio movements to support timely decision-making.

Users can customise reporting periods, metrics and layouts through natural-language instructions. They can also convert reports into dashboards that provide a consolidated view of fund performance.

Linnovate said the tool can produce polished, distribution-ready reports for internal teams, partners and investors.

Faster access to portfolio insights

The company said RAISE AI gives stakeholders faster access to the same trusted data, supporting clearer communication, stronger oversight and better-informed decisions across the investment lifecycle.

“Alternative investments demand clear, current insight at every stage, from portfolio oversight to investor reporting,”

said Henry Lin, Founder and CEO of Linnovate Asset Servicing Group.

“RAISE AI gives the alternative investment community a faster way to get to the answers that matter, and it is a major step in how RAISE supports our clients.”

Lin added that Linnovate would continue investing in people, innovation and technology to develop solutions for the alternative investments market as AI adoption grows and private capital becomes increasingly global.
